what: Photo cards stick (sticky) one after another at 10% + 20px from the screen top and the next card covers the one before — while the next card rises from the screen bottom to the 10% line, the previous card takes that progress with a cubic out and is pushed up 20px, looking as if it recedes behind. The push is not tied directly to scroll but follows at .3s (.1s for one-frame small steps) power2.out, so even one wheel notch feels smooth

options.lift: Distance the front card is pushed up (px), default 20
options.from: Starts pushing when the next card’s top reaches this viewport ratio line, default 1 (bottom of screen)
options.to: Everything gets pushed when it touches this screen ratio line, default .1
options.dur-near: Duration in seconds when the spread is below half of lift, default .1
options.--fx-top: Where the card sticks (css), default calc(10vh + 20px)
options.[data-fx-part=card]: Stacking cards — put the photo in the center of equal-height rows (original 75vh) to match the original look
options.[data-fx-part=end]: (if present) an empty slot after the last card — when this rises, the last card is pushed too (original 120vh)
